motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council DIRECT the Department of Transportation to report with recommendations to address truck activity and idling issues in the Harbor Gateway South community, including the installation of "No Idling" signs and other traffic control measures that would improve safety and reduce the impacts of these large commercial vehicles in the area. title: Harbor Gateway South Community / Truck Activity / Idling Issues / Improve Safety
